description: A date field that opens a calendar popover on desktop and wheel pickers in a drawer on mobile.
overview:
`DatePicker` is a single component that renders a field-style trigger showing the selected date, formatted with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in the `medium` date style, or the placeholder. On desktop the trigger opens a `Popover` containing a single-selection `Calendar`; picking a day selects it and closes the popover.

Below the `48rem` breakpoint the trigger opens a bottom `Drawer` with a `WheelPicker` of day, month and year columns, ordered to match the locale's short date format. Turning a wheel updates the value immediately, and the day is clamped to the length of the chosen month. Use it for form fields such as delivery dates or dates of birth.
usage: Use `value` and `onValueChange` for a controlled field, or `defaultValue` for an uncontrolled one; the value is a `Date` or `null`. `locale` drives the trigger format, calendar captions, weekday names, the first day of the week, day labels and the wheel order. `fromYear` and `toYear` bound both the calendar's months and the year wheel. Pass `id`, `aria-label` and `aria-describedby` to connect the field to a label and help text.

examples.WithValue: Starts with a `defaultValue`, and the calendar opens on that month.
examples.Locale: Formats the trigger and calendar in Turkish with `locale="tr-TR"`.
examples.YearRange: Limits selection to 1940 through 2010 for a date of birth.
examples.WithTitle: Shows a visible Delivery date title in the mobile drawer.
examples.WithCloseButton: Adds an icon close button to the mobile drawer.
examples.WithCloseLabel: Adds a text close button labelled Done to the mobile drawer.
examples.Disabled: Disables the trigger so the picker cannot open.
examples.Controlled: Owns the value in parent state and shows the picked date below the field.
examples.Floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges with `floating`.

parts.DatePicker: The field trigger with its desktop calendar popover and mobile wheel drawer.

DatePicker.value: The selected date when controlled; `null` for no date.
DatePicker.onValueChange: Called with the new date when the user picks a day or turns a wheel.
DatePicker.placeholder: Text shown in the trigger when no date is selected.
DatePicker.locale: BCP 47 locale used for formatting, week start, labels and wheel order; defaults to the runtime locale.
DatePicker.title: Visible title of the mobile drawer; without it the drawer title is visually hidden.
DatePicker.floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges with fully rounded corners.
DatePicker.showCloseButton: Shows a close button in the mobile drawer.
DatePicker.closeLabel: Replaces the drawer's close icon with this text; requires `showCloseButton`.
DatePicker.id: The `id` of the trigger button, for use with a `label`.
DatePicker.className: Classes applied to the trigger button.
DatePicker.aria-invalid: Marks the field invalid and applies the danger border and tint.
DatePicker.aria-label: Accessible name of the trigger; also used as the hidden drawer title when `title` is absent.
DatePicker.aria-describedby: IDs of elements that describe the field, such as help or error text.

accessibility:
- The trigger is a `button`; give it a name with `aria-label` or a `label` linked through `id`.
- On desktop the calendar is a `grid` named by its month caption, and each day button is named with the full localized date, prefixed with today's relative name for the current day.
- `Escape` closes the calendar and returns focus to the trigger.
- On mobile each wheel column is labelled Day, Month or Year, and the drawer always has a title, visually hidden when `title` is not set.
notes: The trigger carries `data-slot="date-picker-trigger"` and `data-placeholder` while empty; the popup carries `data-slot="date-picker-content"` and the wheels `data-slot="date-picker-wheels"`. When no value is set, the mobile wheels start at today's date. The open state is internal and cannot be controlled.
